Chapter 454 - 454 Game; Human Resources Director! (1)

Chapter 454 - 454 Game; Human Resources Director! (1)

454 Game; Human Resources Director! (1)

In the blink of an eye, it was the second day.

Xia Bing, Xia Xue, Liu Qianqian, Nie Zhenjiang, and Jiang Chaoqun were still reading seriously in the office.

Hao Zhiwu, on the other hand, arrived at the Jiangbei branch of Dahua Group early in the morning.

A man in a suit said, “Next, you’ll participate in the closed beta of Dahua Group’s gaming helmet.

“In this internal test, we’ll use the mode of playing for one day and resting for one day. The game time is eight hours per day, and the internal test game time is 56 hours in total. In other words, you’ll have to stay in Dahua Group for 14 days.

“During the internal testing period, Dahua Group will provide accommodation, food, drinks, and closed management of physical examinations. In addition, we’ll offer a subsidy of 5,000 yuan.

“Once you confirm your participation, you’re prohibited from leaving the enclosed area midway. Violators will be fined ten times the subsidy. Do you confirm your participation in the closed beta testing?”

After saying that, he took out a confirmation letter.

Hao Zhiwu’s dream was to play with a gaming helmet.

Moreover, he could get 5,000 yuan for gaming. How could he reject it?

As for forbidding them from leaving the sealed area midway…

It was just 14 days.

For the sake of getting to use a gaming helmet, what did it matter if he was locked up for a year, let alone 14 days?

Hao Zhiwu signed his name without any hesitation.

Then…

Under the guidance of the staff, he and many others came to a hall that was filled with technological equipment.

On the table in the hall, there were exquisite-looking helmets. They were gaming helmets!

Seeing this…

Many people’s hearts could not help but race.

Then, under the guidance of the staff, everyone put on the gaming helmet with curiosity or excitement.

Everyone felt their necks tighten.

In the next moment…

They entered the game.

Some people appeared on a green grassland, some appeared on a golden beach, and some appeared in a dense forest…

No matter where they appeared, everyone’s eyes were wide open, and their faces were filled with disbelief.

In fact, when many people heard that Dahua Group had launched a gaming helmet, they thought it was something similar to VR glasses.

However, what was the situation now?

After putting on the gaming helmet, it was as if they had traveled to another place.

The air was filled with fragrance, clarity, and heat.

There was also the feeling of the grass swaying and the sand falling by their feet.

Someone accidentally fell and even felt some pain!

After a while, everyone let out excited shouts!

They all understood that they had done nothing wrong by participating in the testing this time!

…

On the internet, the matter of the gaming helmet quickly caused a heated discussion.

Feifei Feifei Feifei: [Didn’t Dahua Group’s gaming helmet start their closed beta testing today? Is there still no news?]

Brother Brave: [I don’t know. Logically speaking, we should hear some news soon, right?]

As expected, someone quickly sent a message.

Nameless: [Heavens! This gaming helmet is simply amazing!]

Nameless: [I can guarantee that as long as the gaming helmet is officially released to the market, the popular games that are popular now will all disappear very quickly!]

Guarding the World: [Previous commenter, don’t exaggerate things.]

Nameless: [Exaggerate? This is the truth!]

Happy Happy: [I can vouch for it. I was just in the Dahua Group branch. I just took off the gaming helmet.

[Let’s talk about the overall feeling first.

[One word—stunning!

[I’m very lucky, but also very unlucky.

[I’m lucky because I was selected by Dahua Group to participate in the closed beta test of the gaming helmet. I can experience the gaming helmet for 14 days and a total of 56 hours.

[Unfortunately, I can only experience the gaming helmet for 14 days and a total of 56 hours.

[Gaming experience: This is a high-tech product that is completely different from 3D glasses and VR glasses. It felt as if I had teleported to another place. It was very shocking! All senses are involved—hearing, sight, perception, smell, and others. Of course, it’s also different from the real world. However, in my opinion, this difference is very normal.

[Game image: Extremely exquisite!!!! In other words, at first glance, everything looks real, and there’s no problem with the quality of the image.

[Game world: The world view is very complete, and it has unprecedented freedom…]

As the players participating in the beta test released some updates, the news quickly blew up the entire online world.

Everyone was curious about the gaming helmet.

The day ended with heated discussions.

Hao Zhiwu and many of the selected beta players filled in the forms and went through the corresponding physical examinations.

It had to be said that Dahua Group was very reliable.

After all, they were testing a device that let the consciousness of a person enter the game world. If something happened, it would definitely cause a big problem.

However, in Lin Fan’s opinion, these problems would not happen at all.

…

The next day, the weather was clear and cloudless.

According to the contract signed with Dahua Group, the internal beta testers would undergo a physical examination today before getting some rest.

The selected beta players were all game enthusiasts.

Otherwise, they would not be spending half a month participating in the closed beta test.

In the past, whether they were working or resting, they would always have their minds on gaming.

However, today, they did not have such thoughts.

That was because after playing with the gaming helmet, they were not able to play mobile games, online games, or PSP games… They felt that those were trash!
